name: app-registry-initializeapp-duplicate-name
description: firebase/app initializeApp() a second time under the same name (default '[DEFAULT]') with DIFFERENT options throws FirebaseError code app/duplicate-app, with the name embedded in the message.

behavior.message: Firebase: Firebase App named '[DEFAULT]' already exists with different options. Existing: '{"apiKey":"fake-api-key","projectId":"demo-app-registry","appId":"1:0:web:0"}'. New: '{"apiKey":"fake-api-key","projectId":"a-different-project","appId":"1:0:web:0"}'. (app/duplicate-app).
